newsitem.title: USA: California Micro says settlement final.
newsitem.headline: California Micro says settlement final.

text.p: California Micro Devices Corp said Monday a federal court judge is set to issue a formal written order stating final approval of the firm's settlement of a suit with class action representatives.
The suit, begun in 1994, was brought against California Micro and some of its former officers on behalf of certain shareholders.
Judge Vaughn Walker will issue the order and will make the settlement final and not appealable 30 days after the entry of his order, California Micro said.
The settlement resolves all claims raised against the company and all defendants other than Chan Desaigoudar, a former chairman and chief executive of California Micro.
As outlined in December, the settlement includes payment to the class of $6 million cash and 608,696 shares of common.
In addition, California Micro has assigned to the class its pending claims against Desaigoudar.
The company said the effects of the settlement were included in its financial statements for the quarter ended December 31, 1996.
